sentences.en: Next week we have an exam, and I'm very worried.
This exam is important, because it can decide my grade.
Every night, I review until very late before going to sleep.
As soon as I think about the exam, I feel nervous, and I don't sleep well at night either.
My friend told me: "Don't worry, you've already prepared very well."
Although I'm still a little scared, I decided to rest well and stop studying.
Tomorrow I'm about to take the exam, and I hope there's no problem.

quiz.q: Why is this exam important to the narrator?
a: It's his last chance to enter university
His parents asked him to take it

quiz.q: What did the friend tell him?
a: Don't worry, you've already prepared well

quiz.q: What did he decide to do, even though he was still a little scared?

grammar.e: 因为 introduces the reason for something; the clause it attaches to explains 'why'.
grammar.x: 这次考试很重要，因为它能决定我的成绩。 — This exam is important, because it can decide my grade.

grammar.e: 虽然 introduces a fact that seems to go against what follows; 但是 introduces the actual result, giving a contrast.
grammar.x: 虽然我还是有点儿害怕，但是我决定好好休息，不再看书了。 — Although I'm still a little scared, I decided to rest well and stop studying.

grammar.e: 就要 + verb + 了 shows an action will happen very soon, often with a time word before it.
grammar.x: 明天就要考试了，我希望没问题。 — Tomorrow I'm about to take the exam, and I hope there's no problem.
